title: Reproducibility package for multiscale morphology-informed post-detection verification of deep learning pulmonary nodule candidates in computed tomography: code, trained nnU-Net models, cohort splits and analysis data
description:
Reproducibility package of the study Multiscale morphology-informed post-detection verification of deep learning pulmonary nodule candidates in computed tomography: false-positive reduction, feature repeatability and external validation.

It contains the complete computational pipeline (stages 00–26 and 28–32), the custom nnU-Net trainers and patch, the fifty trained nnU-Net v2.8.1 models (ten configurations × five folds), the cohort definitions and cross-validation splits, the frozen parameters and run records, and the result tables of every stage. Source CT images (LIDC-IDRI, RIDER Lung CT, LNDb) are public and are not redistributed.

Version 1.1.0 adds stages 28–32: the LNDb N1 reference (union of the readers' segmentations of each official lesion) and the re-evaluation of frozen predictions and verifier decisions, selective verification, radiological assessment linkage, Model B, Model C and ablation, and supplementary analyses. All LNDb results use the N1 reference. Models are unchanged.
